en: Two-sided postcard. The back is printed with multilingual captions and address lines, indicating a view of Pécs, Hungary, and credits the photographer Járai MTJ and publisher Képzőművészeti Alap Kiadóvállalata, Budapest. The front shows a black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a large residential district with many mid‑rise apartment blocks arranged in repeating, angled rows, surrounded by scattered houses and cityscape extending toward low hills in the distance.
